title: Freya Brief Dataset Test Strategy

phases.name: Schema validation
phases.goal: Every JSON file parses and references a known brief ID.
checks: All expected-rule records reference an existing brief

phases.name: Brief extraction unit tests
phases.goal: Check that the builder extracts semantic constraints without hardcoding values.

phases.name: Workflow structural tests
phases.goal: Generated workflow matches actual Freya format and API schema.
checks: Every conditional branch has a safe path
Sensitive account lookup gated behind verified identity
Promise calls gated behind explicit confirmation and policy validation

phases.name: Official public benchmark
phases.goal: Run the provided official scorer against the generated phone agent.
checks: Use exact command documented in tools/run_cases.py/help
Inspect per-case ledger, transcript, tool calls, and failure reason
Do not replace official scorer with this synthetic dataset

phases.name: Reliability run
checks: A case is reliable only if all three runs pass
Track policy, outcome, honesty failures separately
Use held-out briefs to measure generalization

release_gates: No account/debt disclosure before verified identity in any regression test.
No duplicate promise record for one agreed promise.
No false success claim after tool failure.
Held-out briefs are not used to hardcode case-specific behavior.
integration_note: The official kit's own docs and tools/run_cases.py define the authoritative invocation and API contract. Inspect those files rather than guessing command-line flags or tool schemas.
